error.message: Live rental prices are not available yet.

success_shape.updatedAt: Actual configured rental policy timestamp, or newer AWS comparison timestamp for a discounted mode
success_shape.formula: Configured per-lease cost plus margin times GPU count and duration; fresh same-card AWS spot/on-demand ratios discount Cheapest and half-discount Balanced. Market medians are comparisons.

options.updatedAt: Actual configured rental policy timestamp, or newer AWS comparison timestamp for a discounted mode
options.discountExpiresAt: earliest actual comparison expiry or null

notes: GPU count, vCPU, RAM, storage and duration are validated against the serving hardware.
Our configured rental rate is independently sourced from the external market median. Missing policy provenance fails closed.

Cheapest carries the fresh AWS spot ratio and an estimated 30 percent longer elapsed duration; Balanced receives half the discount; Fastest uses the full configured rate. These are configured policies, not benchmark measurements.
Expired or missing AWS comparison pairs restore the full configured rate for every mode. They do not expire an otherwise valid own-price policy.
